patterns.name: Chevron threshold over technical field
patterns.intent: Introduce an energetic branded threshold without turning the whole callout into a saturated red block.
observableRules: one full-bleed background raster contains the red/gold V-shaped top seam and pale gray honeycomb body
the pale gray field occupies the main body of the section
the background has no observed transform or animation
the lower edge transitions directly into the pale-blue following section
suitableFor: the homepage TCG Live product callout
a source-faithful generative proof retaining the same callout role

patterns.name: Responsive black copy anchor
patterns.intent: Create a strong, readable explanation and action endpoint beside or after the visually complex product scene.
observableRules: desktop panel is rectangular, translucent black, left aligned in the two-column composition, with 50px 72px padding
mobile panel is opaque black, full width, follows the product scene, and has 30px padding
content is centered H2, one paragraph, and one CTA
no visible kicker
suitableFor: the TCG Live product callout's copy and action group

patterns.name: Five-layer product-world composition
patterns.intent: Show the product ecosystem as an inhabitable scene: devices establish utility, Pikachu provides character recognition, and avatars signal player identity.
observableRules: laptop is the large rear plane
Pikachu overlaps the lower-left laptop edge
phone overlaps the lower-right laptop edge
two avatar hexagons float above the laptop
all five foreground assets are separate transparent rasters
mobile scales the complete group to approximately 374x258.625 while preserving overlap
suitableFor: a generative product-world callout with equivalent evidenced layer semantics
notFor: individual asset used without its evidenced composition role

patterns.name: Breakpoint-specific scene and copy reorder
patterns.intent: Keep the product visual immediate on a narrow screen while preserving comfortable reading in a dedicated full-width panel.
observableRules: desktop reads as copy-left and scene-right
mobile reads as scene-first and copy-second
mobile copy panel spans the full viewport width
the next section begins directly after the black panel
suitableFor: the TCG Live section at desktop and mobile proof widths
notFor: proportional shrinking of the desktop row

patterns.name: Product callout typography stack
patterns.scope: homepage TCG Live black copy panel
patterns.intent: Pair a compact, assertive product name with legible explanatory copy and an obvious action.
observableRules: desktop H2 is Kanit 700 at 40/44 with 1.25px tracking
mobile H2 is Kanit 700 at 28/30.8 with approximately 1px tracking
body is PT Sans 400 at 18/28.8 on both observed widths
CTA is PT Sans 700 at 20/24 desktop and 18/22.5 mobile
all copy is centered and there is no kicker
suitableFor: TCG Live heading, body, and CTA in this callout
forbiddenRoles: hard-coded English or translated line breaks

patterns.name: White action with localized gold hover
patterns.scope: homepage TCG Live Learn More CTA
patterns.intent: Provide a high-contrast exit from the dark panel while using gold only as a restrained interactive foreground response.
observableRules: resting background remains white with black foreground
hover changes the text/icon foreground to rgb(226,186,101)
hover does not change the white background layer
desktop height is 56px and mobile height is approximately 51.297px
activation navigates to /en-us/tcgl/
suitableFor: TCG Live Learn More action in this black panel

patterns.name: Staggered product-scene viewport reveal
patterns.intent: Build the product world progressively: the laptop establishes the stage, then copy and companion layers settle into the composition.
observableRules: laptop transitions from opacity 0 and scale .5 to opacity 1 and scale 1
heading transitions from opacity 0 and translateY 15.398px to settled
paragraph and CTA use the same slide/fade family with later delays
Pikachu, phone, and avatars carry stagger classes
normal incremental scrolling triggers the viewport controller
background remains static
suitableFor: first viewport entry of the TCG Live callout
forbiddenRoles: class-only proof without visible intermediate state

notes: Red is restricted to the background asset's top seam and is not an action or section-fill token.
Gold is restricted to the seam asset and the observed CTA hover foreground.
Black panel styling is restricted to the TCG Live copy group.
Chrome-translated wrapping was not encoded as a layout rule.
